evidence.idea.answers_proposition: Fixture: The idea is plainly a way of saying the proposition, and nothing else is competing with it.
evidence.idea.not_a_competitor: Fixture: Swapping the brand name for a rival's makes the idea stop working.
evidence.idea.headline: Fixture: A single sentence says what the idea is without the brand name explaining it.
evidence.idea.one_thought: Fixture: The idea can be said once and the second half does not argue with the first.
evidence.idea.insight_link: Fixture: The idea visibly grows out of the insight and does not ignore it.
evidence.idea.audience_would_say: Fixture: It is easy to retell, and a friend would get it without the ad.
evidence.idea.surprise: Fixture: It breaks a category habit and does not repeat one.
evidence.idea.reason_to_believe: Fixture: The idea carries, or points at, one of the brief's reasons to believe.
evidence.effect.objective: Fixture: The work would move the objective the brief names and nothing else.
evidence.effect.measure: Fixture: One of the brief's measures would show whether it worked.
evidence.effect.feel_or_do: Fixture: A person can say what the audience will feel or do after meeting it.
evidence.effect.barrier: Fixture: The work takes on the barrier and does not step round it.
evidence.effect.objection: Fixture: The objection is met in the work, not left for the audience to resolve.
evidence.effect.job: Fixture: It does what the brief's job line asks of this piece of work.
evidence.effect.audience_fit: Fixture: The language and the world belong to that audience.
evidence.effect.tone: Fixture: The tone is the tone the brief sets, not a neighbour of it.
evidence.effect.mandatories: Fixture: Nothing in the work breaks a mandatory or a limit the brief sets.
evidence.effect.response_path: Fixture: A person can see what to do or think next.
evidence.craft.script.first_line: Fixture: The opening line gives the listener a reason to stay.
evidence.craft.script.no_repeat: Fixture: No beat only repeats the one before it.
evidence.craft.script.sounds_spoken: Fixture: Read aloud it is speech, not copy.
evidence.craft.script.ends_on_line: Fixture: The last beat lands the idea.
evidence.craft.script.every_word_works: Fixture: Cutting any beat would lose something that matters.
evidence.craft.idea_route.bet_testable: Fixture: A result could show the bet was wrong.
evidence.craft.idea_route.cards_cohere: Fixture: The cards are parts of one route and do not pull apart.
evidence.craft.idea_route.can_be_made: Fixture: Budget, time and channels in the brief allow it.
evidence.craft.idea_route.next_step: Fixture: A first piece of work follows plainly from the route.
evidence.craft.idea_route.range: Fixture: The route can make more than one thing and stay itself.
evidence.craft.visual_brief.territory_clear: Fixture: A person could picture the first frame from the line.
evidence.craft.visual_brief.proposition_visible: Fixture: The proposition would show in the pictures.
evidence.craft.visual_brief.product_role: Fixture: It says how the product shows.
evidence.craft.visual_brief.distinct: Fixture: The look is not the category's usual look.
